sec.title: Master Undated Resolution Pipeline (Batch 4 of 1,607)
sec.p: Continuing **Stage 1** of our systematic backlog resolution across all 80,308 undated broadcasts, **Batch 4** resolves an additional **50 broadcasts** from Edward R. Murrow's *This I Believe* on CBS Radio (Sequences 316 through 365).
This cohort spans giants of social reform, international justice, sportsmanship, literature, and broadcast journalism.
